coordinates: Each character has its own top-left origin; x right, y down; pixels. Female pair-panel x must subtract 1024.
rig_review_status: Female eye and feature placement revised at user request; visual candidate
artwork_source: User-selected male/female portrait; no Guigu pixels, head shape, palette, dimensions, offsets or depth values copied

registration.transform: one uniform similarity transform; no reflection or per-feature warping

slot_contract.hair_front: Visible crown, hairline, temple strands and all hair over the body; no skin or robe pixels
slot_contract.hair_back: Complete continuous rear underpainting including hidden regions; no face hole or shoulder fade
slot_contract.face_shape: Featureless face, original ears and full neck; no hair, features or clothing
slot_contract.eyebrows: Paired original-style painted eyebrows, continuous alpha
slot_contract.eyes: Paired original-style eye organs/lashes; no opaque surrounding skin
slot_contract.nose: Original-style nose pigment and local soft wash; no opaque skin cutout
slot_contract.mouth: Original-style lips and local soft wash; no opaque skin cutout
slot_contract.clothing: Whole robe, clean neckline and no hair
slot_contract.face_accessory: Male beard only; female blush/makeup only; empty defaults valid
